name: create_maintenance_visit_from_roadcall
script:
# 1. Fetch only the document ID to prevent SQL column selection errors
unprocessed_dispatches = frappe.get_all("CRM Deal", 
    filters={
        "custom_maintenance_visit_created": 0
    },
    fields=["name"]
)

processed_count = 0
skipped_count = 0
deal_logs = []

# FIXED: Safe array index lookup to extract the exact internal primary key ID
existing_sp = frappe.get_all("Sales Person", filters={"is_group": 0}, fields=["name"], limit=1)

if existing_sp and len(existing_sp) > 0:
    sales_person_target = existing_sp[0].get("name")
else:
    try:
        # On-the-fly fallback generation if no master records exist
        sp_doc = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Sales Person",
            "sales_person_name": "Default Dispatcher",
            "is_group": 0
        })
        sp_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        sales_person_target = sp_doc.name
    except Exception as sp_err:
        sales_person_target = None

# 2. Process each deal safely
for summary in unprocessed_dispatches:
    try:
        # Lazy-load the full document data into memory safely
        deal = frappe.get_doc("CRM Deal", summary.get("name"))
        
        # Verify if this deal is in the Dispatched stage
        current_stage = deal.get("stage") or deal.get("status")
        if str(current_stage).lower() != "dispatched":
            continue
            
        # Parse customer info using standard Frappe CRM keys
        raw_customer = deal.get("organization") or deal.get("lead") or deal.get("customer_name") or deal.get("customer")
        fallback_name = "Driver - " + str(deal.get("vehicle_reg")) if deal.get("vehicle_reg") else "Emergency Driver"
        target_customer = raw_customer if raw_customer else fallback_name
        
        # Check and generate Customer if missing
        if not frappe.db.exists("Customer", target_customer):
            cust = frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "Customer",
                "customer_name": target_customer,
                "customer_type": "Individual",
                "customer_group": "Individual",
                "territory": "All Territories"
            })
            cust.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            resolved_customer = cust.name
        else:
            resolved_customer = target_customer
            
        # Safe item assignment via a direct single-value lookup
        service_item = "Roadside Service Fee"
        if not frappe.db.exists("Item", service_item):
            service_item = frappe.db.get_value("Item", {"disabled": 0}, "name")

        if not service_item:
            skipped_count += 1
            deal_logs.append("Deal " + str(deal.name) + ": Skipped (No active Item found)")
            continue

        if not sales_person_target:
            skipped_count += 1
            deal_logs.append("Deal " + str(deal.name) + ": Skipped (Mandatory Sales Person master link could not be resolved)")
            continue

        # Build description safely from optional attributes
        v_make = deal.get("vehicle_make") or ""
        v_model = deal.get("vehicle_model") or ""
        v_reg = deal.get("vehicle_reg") or ""
        b_reason = deal.get("breakdown_reason") or ""
        
        desc = "Vehicle: " + str(v_make) + " " + str(v_model) + " | Plate: " + str(v_reg) + " | Issue: " + str(b_reason)

        # Generate the operational Maintenance Visit record
        mv = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Maintenance Visit",
            "customer": resolved_customer,
            "mntc_date": frappe.utils.nowdate(),
            "completion_status": "Unresolved",
            "maintenance_type": "Corrective",
            "maintenance_visit_by": "Internal",
            # FIXED: Providing both schema possibilities to satisfy parent validation checks
            "service_person": sales_person_target,
            "sales_person": sales_person_target
        })
        
        # Append child table rows utilizing native ORM methods
        mv.append("purposes", {
            "item_code": service_item,
            "description": desc,
            "maintenance_type": "Corrective",
            "work_done": "Dispatched to site. Work in progress.",
            # FIXED: Injecting agent into both possible schema fields simultaneously 
            "sales_person": sales_person_target,
            "service_person": sales_person_target
        })
        
        mv.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        
        # Map back references into the primary CRM Deal row
        frappe.db.set_value("CRM Deal", deal.name, {
            "custom_maintenance_visit_created": 1,
            "custom_linked_ticket": mv.name
        })
        
        processed_count += 1
        deal_logs.append("Deal " + str(deal.name) + ": Ticket " + str(mv.name) + " successfully created.")
        
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.db.rollback()
        skipped_count += 1
        deal_logs.append("Error processing Deal " + str(summary.get("name")) + ": " + str(e))
        continue

# Output results cleanly to the web browser tab as JSON
frappe.response["message"] = {
    "status": "Execution Completed",
    "total_matching_pool": len(unprocessed_dispatches),
    "successfully_processed": processed_count,
    "skipped_or_failed": skipped_count,
    "log": deal_logs
}

# Check if the address field has text and isn't empty
if doc.breakdown_address:
    
    # Clean up common text characters so they form a valid web link
    # This manually strips spaces and messy formatting without external libraries
    address_string = doc.breakdown_address
    url_safe_address = address_string.replace(" ", "%20").replace("\n", "%20").replace(",", "%2C")
    
    # Formulate the definitive Google Maps link
    maps_link = f"https://google.com{url_safe_address}"
    
    # Inject it directly into the location field
    doc.breakdown_location = maps_link
